name: Lithuania

observations.reasoning: Sourced on 2026-07-27, transversal pass over the population indicator. Population on 1 January 2025: 2890664 inhabitants, recorded as 2.891 million. Eurostat dataset demo_pjan, Population on 1 January by age and sex, read through the dissemination API on 2026-07-27, dataset last updated 2026-07-09. Total population, both sexes, all ages, which is exactly what this indicator's denominator asks for. Read as one table covering every country in the record, so no value here is derived from a neighbour: each is that country's own row. The previous value was an opening estimate produced with no source and no research.

Checked on 2026-07-27 against the two register pages of the Teatro informacijos centras, which sorts Lithuanian theatres by founder: national and state theatres on one page, municipal theatres on the other. Three puppet houses appear across the two. Kauno valstybinis lėlių teatras, Laisvės al. 87A in Kaunas, on the state list. Vilniaus teatras 'Lėlė', Arklių g. 5 in Vilnius, on the municipal list, registered as a biudžetinė įstaiga — a budgetary institution — and carrying a page on the history of its own building. Klaipėdos lėlių teatras, Vežėjų g. 4 in Klaipėda, on the municipal list, founded 13 September 2000. The Klaipėda entry carries a caveat worth stating rather than burying: the body is registered as a VšĮ, a public establishment, a form that can also be founded privately. What places it inside the count is the register, which files it under municipal theatres; if that classification is wrong the Lithuanian figure is 2. The opening estimate of 3 to 4 came from a note listing Vilnius, Kaunas, Klaipėda and Panevėžys as state puppet theatres. Two of the four claims were wrong. Only Kaunas is a state theatre — Vilnius and Klaipėda are municipal — and Panevėžys appears on neither register, so the Panevėžio lėlių vežimo teatras has no public founder and falls outside the denominator. The note has been corrected.

Web check of 2026-07-27, searched in the country's own language. One establishment retained: the Lithuanian Academy of Music and Theatre, on its Klaipeda campus. Criterion read at source: a Puppet and Object Theatre specialism open within the Theatre Arts bachelor's degree, with a curriculum naming puppet theatre history, puppet dramaturgy and animation work. The award is therefore Theatre Arts, with puppetry as a named specialism inside it, which satisfies the denominator without occupying the main title. The previous value of 0.5 was the midpoint of an estimated range. Caveat: the page read does not confirm the academy's state status, presumed here from its national character but not verified. Upper bound at 2, no source read claiming exhaustiveness.

establishments.description: The Klaipėda faculty of the Lithuanian Academy of Music and Theatre. Puppetry is a named specialism inside the theatre arts degree rather than a degree of its own, covering puppet history, puppet dramaturgy and animation technique.

observations.reasoning: DISPUTED. First value produced as a mean conditioned on artists who actually tour, which drops from the denominator the makers who do not perform. Method error identified: a fee is not a performance. For France the true median probably sits between 10 and 20, over a bimodal distribution. For countries with permanent companies, recomputed from the top: 250 to 400 performances a year, casts of 3 to 5, a company of about twenty, so on the order of 50 to 90. To be redone in full once the denominator is settled.

performances: settled negative, 2026-07-27. Statistics Lithuania does not isolate puppetry. Its 'Teatro tipas' dimension means state against non-state, not genre (S3R512, S3R513), and the two performance tables S3R575 and S3R810 carry no type dimension at all. A figure would have to be built by adding the three houses' own reports, which is constructing a number rather than reading one. No observation recorded.
